lines.text: Many learners say: How many time do you need?
Better: How much time do you need?
Use much with time, not many.
Much! How much time do you have?

data.wrong: How many time do you need?
data.right: How much time do you need?
data.why: Use much with time, not many.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt dùng “bao nhiêu” cho mọi thứ, nhưng tiếng Anh dùng “much” với “time”.
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “How many time do you need?” không? ⏰ Với “time” dùng “much”: “How much time do you need?” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “much”. Hỏi bạn bè bằng “How much time…” thử xem nhé! Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Vietnamese uses “bao nhiêu” for everything, but English uses “much” with “time”.
en.caption: Do you often say “How many time do you need?”? Say “How much time do you need?” instead. Listen to Carlos, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
